title: Wiemer waitlist
description: A pale grey band with a centred orange mono tag, a huge launch heading and a short paragraph, then a near-white form card floating on a perforated-plate field of pale dots: a price box with two mono prices, an email field, a consent checkbox and a full-width blue submit bar. Heading letters rise in as it scrolls into view; dots darken where the pointer passes.
notes: a plain HTML form (action prop); no JavaScript
the dot field shows from lg up; on phones the card spans the width
